claim_one_line: ROUTE A RUN: THE ARITHMETIC OBSTRUCTION B990 PREDICTED IS ABSENT. B990 proved the orbit-to-point gap STRUCTURAL -- an orbit invariant is constant on the orbit, so no refinement of it can ever pick a point -- and named exactly two routes across, Route A being to shrink the group and count G(Z)-orbits inside the object's G(Q)-orbit, since 'if it is 1, the integral orbit is a canonical point up to G(Z), which is exactly what a VEV direction needs'. B990 attached an explicit UNFAVOURABLE prior ('class numbers of this kind are generically > 1, and the programme's history is a record of homogeneity winning'), ADOPTED HERE UNCHANGED. The rational orbit is classified by the cubic etale algebra K = Q[x]/(x^3-12x-5), and integral orbits inside one rational orbit are counted, in every correspondence of this Kato-Yukie / Bhargava type, by a class-group-type quantity of K. Rather than assume which, ALL candidates were computed: h = 1 (already banked, NOT this arc's finding), the NARROW class number h+ = 1 (new), |Cl/Cl^2| = 1, |Cl/Cl^3| = 1. MECHANISM for h+ = 1: the unit signature map is SURJECTIVE onto {+-1}^3 -- the fundamental units x^2+2x-4 (norm +1) and 3x^2+6x+2 (norm -1) have sign vectors [1,1,0] and [0,1,0], which with -1's [1,1,1] span F_2^3, rank 3 of 3, image 8 of 8, so h+ = h*2^3/8 = 1. B990'S PRIOR DID NOT HOLD. WHAT THIS MEANS AT EXACTLY ITS STRENGTH: the arithmetic obstruction Route A was expected to meet is ABSENT -- whichever class-group quantity governs the integral orbit count, it is trivial, which is why all four were computed, so the conclusion does not depend on resolving which applies. WHAT IT DOES NOT MEAN: it does NOT say the integral orbit count is 1; identifying which quantity counts integral orbits is Kato-Yukie/Bhargava integral theory and is REGISTERED AS OWED, NOT ASSERTED. This arc removes the obstruction B990 predicted; it does not by itself deliver the canonical point. CONTROLS: two independent engines -- PARI/GP bnfinit/bnfnarrow, and an independent sympy route with units verified by resultant norm +-1, signs by exact evaluation at the three real roots and the F_2 rank by hand elimination -- both giving h+ = 1; and the field verified before any class datum is read (disc = poldisc = 6237 = 3^4*7*11 so Z[x]/(f) is maximal; irreducible; signature [3,0] totally real). PREREGISTERED before the narrow class number was computed. P0: the ALGEBRA AND ITS ARITHMETIC, not a manifold. Gate 5 untouched -- a VEV direction is a direction in an algebra; no value or scale enters.
